name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Anna Moon and David Moon, married two years by the time you arrived. She was a chef, he was an architect. Nothing extravagant, but nobody checked the price of things. You were the youngest of 3: Karen and Claire were already running the house. Your father David ran lights at the local theatre and let you sit in the empty stalls. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Anna Moon and David Moon — a comfortable household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
